items.summary: The FloatingWhatsApp component must dynamically fetch the WhatsApp phone number from the backend canister (via the site settings query) instead of using a hardcoded or stale cached value. After the admin saves a new WhatsApp number in AdminSettings, the FloatingWhatsApp button must use the updated number immediately — ensure the React Query cache for site settings is invalidated or refetched after a successful save in AdminSettings so the customer-facing button always reflects the current backend value.
